At nLIGHT, we are constantly on the cutting-edge of laser technology in a massively growing market. We are a leading provider of high-power semiconductors and fiber lasers for industrial, microfabrication, and aerospace & defense applications, to name a few. Our lasers are changing not only the way things are made, but also changing the things that can be made.

Headquartered in Camas, Washington, nLIGHT is a publicly listed company (NASDAQ: LASR).

Position Summary

The Product Software Development team at nLIGHT delivers high-quality software for a rapidly growing portfolio of laser products. We are seeking a highly motivated software engineer with a strong record of technical execution, creativity, and product-focused development. In this role, you will contribute to the architecture, design, development, testing, deployment, and support of customer-facing applications, internal tools, and supporting infrastructure. Because this is a small team with broad impact, the ideal candidate is collaborative, adaptable, and comfortable working in a dynamic engineering environment. This position will be hybrid with 2-3 days per week onsite in Camas, WA.

Key Responsibilities


Partner with colleagues, internal stakeholders, field service teams, and customers to understand feature needs, clarify requirements, and manage priorities.
Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain customer-facing software applications and internal engineering tools.

Collaborate with the development team on software architecture, technical design, implementation planning, and code quality.
Design and implement clean, scalable code using C#, .NET, and related technologies.
Experience with source control, specifically Git.
Create and maintain appropriate documentation throughout the software development life cycle.
Provide application expertise, troubleshooting support, and technical guidance to internal users and field service partners.
Advocate for engineering best practices and mentor team members or partners where appropriate.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
5+ years of experience developing software applications for PC or Windows environments.
Proven experience developing applications with .NET technologies.
Strong proficiency with C#.
Familiarity with application architecture patterns and APIs such as REST or RPC.
Experience creating, maintaining, or supporting Windows installers.
Experience using Microsoft development tools, including Visual Studio.
Excellent troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience working with data repositories using SQL, stored procedures, or related database technologies.
Familiarity with developing, deploying, or supporting Azure applications and services.
Experience with Windows administration, configuration management, continuous integration, or continuous deployment practices.
Familiarity with embedded software development or software that interfaces with hardware systems.


Professional Attributes


Collaborates effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented engineering environment.
Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.
Demonstrates strong attention to detail and the ability to quickly absorb, organize, and apply new information.
Works independently from high-level goals while proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and next steps.
Comfortable providing technical direction, coordinating work, or guiding others when needed.
Adapts well to changing priorities and contributes constructively to continuous improvement.

About Guru Technologies

Guru Technologies is a Utah-based software engineering and technology consulting firm helping organizations solve complex business challenges through custom software development, artificial intelligence, cloud engineering, data & analytics, quality engineering, DevOps, mobile applications, enterprise integrations, and digital transformation.




For over 20 years, we’ve partnered with organizations ranging from innovative startups to Fortune 500 enterprises. Our mission is simple: build exceptional technology while creating long-term partnerships built on trust, technical excellence, and measurable business outcomes.




At Guru, you’ll work alongside experienced software engineers, architects, designers, and technology leaders who are passionate about solving meaningful business challenges. We believe our people are our greatest asset and are committed to creating an environment where collaboration, continuous learning, and long-term career growth thrive.




About the Role

Guru Technologies is looking for an experienced C#/.NET software engineer who can design, build, and deliver reliable software using both strong engineering fundamentals and modern AI-assisted development tools.

This role is not primarily about memorizing syntax or framework trivia. AI can now generate substantial amounts of code, but experienced engineers are still needed to understand the business problem, design the right system, direct the work, identify risks, and verify that the final result is secure, maintainable, and production-ready.

We are looking for someone with a strong systems-engineering mindset who can take an unclear or complex problem, develop a sound technical approach, break it into manageable pieces, and use both people and AI agents effectively.

Hands-on exposure to tools such as Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar solutions is expected. These tools are new, so we do not require years of experience with them. We do expect candidates to demonstrate meaningful experimentation and explain how they have used AI to solve real engineering problems.

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain software using C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET, APIs, relational databases, and related web technologies.
Participate in the full software lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through deployment and production support.
Translate business needs into clear technical plans, system designs, data models, APIs, and acceptance criteria.
Evaluate tradeoffs involving scalability, security, performance, cost, complexity, and maintainability.
Use AI coding assistants and agents for appropriate tasks such as planning, implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, documentation, and code review.
Provide AI agents with clear context, constraints, architectural direction, and expected outcomes.
Review and validate AI-generated code rather than accepting it at face value.
Identify hallucinations, incomplete implementations, unnecessary complexity, security risks, and regressions.
Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, infrastructure, monitoring, and production systems.
Collaborate with engineers, designers, project managers, and clients.
Mentor less-experienced developers and help improve engineering practices across the team.
Occasionally contribute to front-end applications using HTML, CSS, TypeScript, React, Angular, or similar technologies.

AI tools are expected to improve your output, not replace your judgment. Engineers remain accountable for the software they deliver.

Required Qualifications
Five or more years of professional software engineering experience.
Strong experience with C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, APIs, and relational databases.
Experience designing and delivering production software from initial concept through deployment.
Strong understanding of architecture, data modeling, API design, testing, debugging, source control, and software security.
Ability to understand complex interactions across applications, databases, cloud infrastructure, and third-party systems.
Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or a comparable cloud platform.
Familiarity with Git, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD.
Hands-on exposure to at least one modern AI-assisted or agentic development tool.
Ability to demonstrate how you have used AI to investigate, design, implement, test, debug, or improve software.
Ability to critically review AI-generated output and verify that it works correctly.
Strong problem-solving, systems-thinking, communication, and organizational skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal direction while remaining collaborative and accountable.

We care more about engineering judgment, problem-solving, and the ability to validate results than memorized syntax or obscure framework knowledge.

Helpful Experience
Docker and containerized applications.
Infrastructure as code using AWS CDK, Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tools.
AWS ECS, Fargate, Lambda, or comparable Azure services.
Domain-driven design, clean architecture, onion architecture, or similar approaches.
React, Angular, Vue, TypeScript, or other modern front-end technologies.
Distributed systems, queues, background processing, or microservices.
Legacy application modernization.
AI APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, tool use, or workflow automation.
Repository instructions, MCP integrations, reusable agent workflows, or multi-agent development.
Consulting, professional services, SaaS, construction technology, or enterprise software experience.
Experience working directly with clients to clarify requirements and recommend solutions.
Education

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field is helpful but not required. Relevant experience and demonstrated ability are more important than a specific degree.

What We Offer
Competitive compensation based on experience and demonstrated capability.
Flexible working hours.
Hybrid work with three days per week in our Layton office.
Health, dental, and vision insurance.
Paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays.
401(k) with company match.
Opportunities to work across a wide range of industries, products, and technologies.
Access to modern AI-assisted engineering tools.
A collaborative culture that values strong engineers, sustainable work, and long-term professional growth.
Applying

Please submit your resume and be prepared to discuss:

A significant system or feature you helped design and deliver.
A difficult technical tradeoff you made.
An AI-assisted development tool you have used.
A specific example of how you used it.
How you reviewed and validated the resulting work.

Applicants are not expected to be experts in every technology listed. We are looking for experienced engineers with strong fundamentals, sound judgment, practical AI exposure, and the ability to continue learning as software development evolves.
